name: Irondeep Supplies
label: Quest
description: Irondeep Supplies: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Stormpike dwarves are using the Irondeep mine as a storage depot. I want you to raid that mine and bring me its supplies. This will curtail the Stormpikes' efforts in Alterac Valley, and will provide us with needed equipment!
Be wary, friend. The Irondeep mine is deep in Alliance territory, and control of the mine is as shifting as the snows of Alterac.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you enter the Irondeep mine, friend? Did you raid its supplies?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got them! Nicely done, friend! And I hope you saw a few dwarves during your raid, and shed their blood for the Frostwolves!
